card.name: Words leading up to dropping out
card.fires_on: Words just before an expected 'drop out' or 'discontinue', such as 'will', 'rate of', 'students', or 'patients' in talk of students leaving school or patients stopping treatment.

modes.label: Students leaving school
modes.description: Words before 'drop out' or 'not finish' in text about high school or college students quitting.
modes.example: They will drop out. Of the three million students that enrolled in college this year, 40 percent<< will>> not finish.

modes.label: Patients stopping treatment
modes.description: Words before discontinuation or drop-out in clinical trial or label text.
modes.example: These symptoms were severe in 2% of patients; and 2.1% of<< patients>> discontinued therapy as a result.
